title: Awakening

vibeProfile.oneLine: A wife and mother wakes to a freedom her world will not allow.

summary: On the Louisiana coast, Edna Pontellier, a respectable wife and mother, awakens to her own desires and her longing for a self beyond marriage and motherhood, with consequences her society cannot allow. Kate Chopin's short, lyrical novel scandalised readers in 1899 and was nearly forgotten before being rediscovered as a landmark of early feminist fiction. Sensuous and quietly radical, it is a haunting study of a woman reaching for a freedom the world will not grant her.
whyReadIt: A short, sensuous, ahead-of-its-time novel of a woman's awakening. Buried on release, now rightly a feminist classic.

funFacts.text: The novel was so condemned in 1899 that Chopin published little afterward; it was rediscovered decades later.
